metadata.note: Security-only report (AppCAT was not run or failed)

security.title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
security.description: The product does not neutralize or incorrectly neutralizes user-controllable input before it is placed in output that is used as a web page that is served to other users.

evidence.explanation: In reports.jsp, several database-sourced values are rendered into HTML using bare JSP EL expressions without HTML escaping, enabling stored Cross-Site Scripting.

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Password
security.description: The product contains a hard-coded password, which it uses for its own inbound authentication or for outbound communication to external components.

evidence.explanation: compliance.properties contains a hard-coded plaintext database password committed directly to source control.

security.title: Use of Obsolete Function
security.description: The code uses deprecated or obsolete functions, which suggests that the code has not been actively reviewed or maintained.

evidence.explanation: Class.forName() for JDBC driver registration (obsolete since JDBC 4.0) and non-thread-safe static SimpleDateFormat (superseded by DateTimeFormatter since Java 8).

security.title: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context
security.description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.

evidence.explanation: Static DATE_FORMAT SimpleDateFormat accessed by concurrent request threads without synchronization. SimpleDateFormat is not thread-safe.

security.title: Missing Release of Resource after Effective Lifetime
security.description: The product does not release a resource after its effective lifetime has ended.

evidence.explanation: HttpURLConnection opened but never disconnected in resolveTokenFromAuthGateway().

security.title: Missing Release of File Descriptor or Handle after Effective Lifetime
security.description: The product does not release a file descriptor or handle after its effective lifetime has ended.

evidence.explanation: HttpURLConnection handle opened but conn.disconnect() is never called in any code path.

security.title: Insufficient Logging
security.description: When a security-critical event occurs, the product either does not record the event or omits important details about the event when logging it.

evidence.explanation: No logging framework present. All exception handlers silently discard errors. Security-critical events go completely unrecorded.

security.title: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
security.description: The product contains hard-coded credentials, such as a password or cryptographic key.

evidence.explanation: Hard-coded SQL Server SA credentials (db.user=sa, db.password) committed to source control, shipped in every WAR artifact.

security.title: Missing Synchronization
security.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.

evidence.explanation: Static DATE_FORMAT accessed in loadReports() by concurrent threads with no synchronization mechanism whatsoever.

security.title: Data Access Operations Outside of Expected Data Manager Component
security.description: The product uses a dedicated, central data manager component as required by design, but it contains code that performs data-access operations that do not use this data manager.

evidence.explanation: All data-accessing classes bypass a DAO/Repository layer and directly execute SQL inline within servlet/service logic.
